title: The waterway alternative for a paper mill's replacement raw-water pipe bridge, the smallest that passes the river's 1 per cent annual chance flood at the company's own stage gauge
subdomain: hydrology and flood frequency (the 1 per cent annual chance peak discharge at a stage-only gauge, from its annual peak stages and its field discharge measurements)
prompt_shape: one dial (seven waterway alternatives by capacity) against the 1 per cent design discharge; ten work windows' highest stages with dates; six water years' pipe-bridge levels and falls at the gauge's crest; a frequency-curve chart

distractors.why_relevant: the rain at the mill in the same valley drives the floods the design flow is about
distractors.why_unused: the design flood comes from the gage's own annual peaks; no figure reads the rain record
distractors.ruled_out_by: the alternatives study section 3 and Engineering Standard 4.2.2 (the gage's annual peak series)

distractors.why_relevant: the mill's other gage in the valley, with annual peak discharges from a stable rating
distractors.why_unused: the generalized skew is set by the standard and the design flood is at TUM-02; no figure reads it
distractors.ruled_out_by: Engineering Standard 4.2.2 and 4.2.4 (the structure's own gage, the filed generalized skew)
